title: Separate review and test-generation steps with role-specific tools and a forced output contract
expected_outcome: The review step gets read-only tools and the finding schema; the test step gets its own schema. Each returns structured output, never prose. In the Messages API the same guarantee is tool_choice {type: tool, name: report_findings}.

findings.suggested_fix: Iterate over every item, e.g. `for item in items: total += item.qty`, or `range(len(items))` to keep the indexed form.

proposed.scenario: A stock list holding one item, e.g. [SimpleNamespace(sku="A1", qty=4)], should total 4. As written, the PR 418 loop starts at index 1, skips the only item and returns 0, so a SKU's whole quantity disappears from the total.

Using the empty_stock fixture, total_qty should return 0 and not raise. This should pass today, and it guards the empty-warehouse case when the loop is fixed, for example against a rewrite that indexes items[0].
